partitions.calibration: independent score thresholds, probability mapping and coverage schedule; no model selection using untouched test
partitions.untouched_test: sealed by default; opened once by independent steward after protocol/references are locked

accepted_input.schema: numeric s or ms clock on declared timebase; named pressure and signed mass flow with explicit role, native unit and polarity
accepted_input.metadata: topology optional for in-domain intake; required to substantiate topology transfer; record intervention truth, physical event onset/end, root and family, parent receipts, known shared histories and SHA-256
accepted_input.provenance: independent review registry hash pinned out of band and bound to exact manifest and source receipts

requirements.multiclass: class-complete independent producing families for NORMAL/LEAK/FAULT/DELAY in all partitions; class-specific source mechanism and verified onset/offset; prospective causal observation protocol; precision design by independent unit
requirements.localization: predeclared candidates, traceable actual location for every supported leak, independent root and per-site coverage in each relevant partition; report conditional set coverage, wrong singleton and set size
requirements.calibration: independent representative calibration, frozen model and score contract, independent untouched evaluation; prespecified bins/score metric and family-based uncertainty
requirements.formal: qualified simultaneous observation and prediction enclosures; units, signed flow, clock synchronization, boundary/initial, parameter, numerical and independent model discrepancy bounds, domain receipt
requirements.incremental_value: same original observations, hypotheses and source roots; classifier-only, calibrated abstention and formal policy; preregister paired selective-risk comparison at attained nonzero matched coverage, limits and uncertainty
requirements.normal_reference: prospectively available and time synchronized nominal model or acquisition record; matched experimental counterfactual is excluded from operational mode

precision: Choose minima prospectively from operational detection/false-episode/diagnostic targets, independent-unit variability and desired interval precision. A class-present split alone is not adequate.
missing_now: synchronized actuator command and actual response with measured nominal lag
